NETWORK CONFIRMED OPEN: steamcommunity.com 200, upload.wikimedia.org, i.imgur.com, youtube.com, flickr, reddit all reachable. images.nexusmods.com 403.

STEAM PIPELINE WORKS: listing https://steamcommunity.com/app/<appid>/screenshots/?p=N&browsefilter=toprated gives sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=NNN links. Detail page needs `curl --compressed` (gzip) else binary garbage. Detail page yields: ActualMedia img src -> strip ?query to get ORIGINAL bytes at https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/<a>/<b>/ ; plus detailsStatRight fields = size, date posted, WxH; apphub_AppName = game.
Sample Elden Ring original: 3840x1608 JPEG, 6.97 bits/px = high quality, NOT recompressed. But ultrawide -> reject per §6. Must filter aspect ~16:9.
App IDs: Elden Ring 1245620, Skyrim SE 489830, RDR2 1174180, Witcher 3 292030, ESO 306130.
yt-dlp installs via pip (2026.7.4). NO ffmpeg in container -> cannot merge DASH streams or trim; must use progressive/single-file formats for video/.

This task WROTE NOTHING under corpus/70-visual/refs/ before standing down — zero files created, modified or deleted anywhere in the repo except this status file. Steam search endpoint quirk banked for whoever resumes acquisition: /workshop/browse/?appid=X&section=screenshots&searchtext=Q works ONLY for apps with no Steam Workshop (Elden Ring 1245620 -> 21 hits). For apps that HAVE a workshop (Witcher 3 292030, Skyrim SE 489830) that URL renders the mod workshop and yields zero screenshots. Universal endpoint that works for all: https://steamcommunity.com/app/<appid>/screenshots/?p=N&browsefilter=toprated&searchText=Q (11 results/page, paginate with p).

Steam detail-page scraper + original-bytes fetcher written and verified at scratchpad/steam.py; ~/harvest.py drives it. Not committed (out of scope after stand-down) but the mechanics are described in the finding above.
